**Finding: deviation (high) — § 4(c), paragraph p0021**

The only licence grant in our favour is the § 4(c) licence-back of Contractor's Information incorporated into the Works. It is already royalty-free, non-exclusive, perpetual and sublicensable, but it deviates from our playbook position in three respects:

1. **Affiliates/contractors not covered** — the grant runs to "Company" alone, so our group companies and the contractors who operate and maintain the deliverables have no licence.
2. **Not irrevocable** — "perpetual" alone does not foreclose a purported revocation; the playbook requires paid-up licences to be perpetual *and* irrevocable.
3. **No successor transfer** — the grant is silent on transfer while § 10 (NONASSIGNABILITY, p0042) bars assignment or transfer without consent, so the licence may not follow our business in an M&A transaction.

Redline validated (ok:true) as a single minimal replacement inserting "and its affiliates", "irrevocable", contractor exercise rights, and successor transferability, leaving the balance of the grant untouched. Fallback offered in the comment: affiliates on written notice and transferability limited to an M&A successor.
